terminalReview.note: Machine-specific defeat/shutdown outcomes; Goldie escapes. No invented requirement to kill pilots; generic current clear overlay is not a bespoke terminal animation.

productionCountPolicy.unit: distinct authored action clip with its own start/end poses, events and anchors; not frames or renamed timing states
productionCountPolicy.note: 30+ means at least31 distinct authored actions, never31frames or timing labels. If applied perboss the lower bound is372; exact perboss requested inventory/IDs belong to producerG. Current Codebreak36item request is unproduced. This review does not invent generation records or mark a backlog complete.

reviewLimitations: Neutral samples do not trigger every attack, target opening, route gate, transformation or terminal outcome. Later timing and conditional actions were source-reviewed, not browser-observed.
All24phase keyframes and96timed renders are actual offline Chrome diagnostics, not human motion signoff.
Screenshot changes can be caused by autofire/HUD; differences alone do not prove machine articulation.
No final clips, transformation animations or boss-specific terminal animations are integrated.
No Higgsfield generation, spend, production signoff or earned-clear claim.
